text: Murloc Ritualists are murlocs appearing in the Founding of Durotar campaign.
The Mur'gul Tyrant is the mur'gul leader in Echo Isles, appearing in the Founding of Durotar campaign. It dropped Scepter of the Sea upon death.
The Mur'gul Overlord is a mur'gul leader appearing in Dustwallow Marsh in the Founding of Durotar campaign.
Murky Cerulean Signet drops from Aqu'sirr in the Shrine of the Storm.
The Murktide lobstrok inhabit the southern coast of Tanaan Jungle as well as the Cave of Betrayal.
__NOTOC__ The Murloc Shoals was a location in Suramar. This area served as the base of operations for the Seerspine murlocs.
The Murloc Oppressor's Band drops from Subjugator Kor'ul at the Shrine of Gelihast in Blackfathom Deeps.
__NOTOC__ Murloc Tidehunters are murlocs located along the southwestern coast of Westfall.
__NOTOC__ Murloc Warriors are murlocs located along the western coast of Westfall.
__NOTOC__ Murloc Coastrunners are murlocs located at the northern coast of Westfall.
__NOTOC__ Murloc Raiders are murlocs located at the northern coast of Westfall.
Murkbloom Reefwalkers are coral ancients located at the Spears of Azshara in Nazjatar.
Murderbeak is an axebeak located at Backwater Beach in Zuldazar. It can be summoned by using the Chum Bucket.

__NOTOC__ Murloco is a murloc located at Murloco's Hideaway in Nazjatar. He is initially trapped and must be freed by defeating waves of naga enemies. He will then stay for five minutes, selling his goods.
Murloco's Hideaway is a cave located in Nazjatar. It is Murloco's hideaway.
Murgle is a bloodfin baby murloc drops from King Gakula at Bloodfin Village of Nazjatar.
Mushu Cloudmane is a tauren druid located in Warfang Hold in Stormsong Valley.
Murloco's Marvelous Hat is located in Murloco's Hideaway in Nazjatar. After saving Murloco the hat can be donned and worn for 15 minutes.
The Mundane Ookin' Curio is a quest reward from No Time for Tryouts. Its proc can summon Ooker Dooker to assist you in combat.
Murloc Netters are murlocs located along the northwestern coast of Westfall.
The Murhfathom Reach was a subzone planned for Stormsong Valley.
Munitions Officers are humans located on an unnamed ship in Tiragarde Sound.
Murphy is a pug located in Freehold. This dog carries the key for the Freehold Jail.
Murloc Spearhunters are murlocs located at the Murloc Hideaway in Exile's Reach.
Murloc Watershapers are murlocs located at the Murloc Hideaway in Exile's Reach.
Murloc Patrons are murlocs located in Mrgl's Bar and Gill in Nazjatar.
Murktide Squallweavers are lobstrok located in the Cave of Betrayal and at Scuttler's Coast in Tanaan Jungle.
The Murktide's Coveted Chestplate drops from Glub'glok in the Cave of Betrayal in Tanaan Jungle.
Murktide Slashclaws are lobstrok located in the Cave of Betrayal and at Scuttler's Coast in Tanaan Jungle.
Murktide Hatchlings are lobstrok located in the Cave of Betrayal and at Scuttler's Coast in Tanaan Jungle.
Murktoads are frogs located in the Shrouded Mire and the Faraway Pools in Ardenweald.
Mushroom Manglers are faeries located in the Stalks in Ardenweald.
The Murder Mystery is looted from Dusty Books in the Ember Ward in Revendreth. The book can be handed in to Lord Scowl in return for access to the Secret Treasure.
Murrol Fuseless is a Maldraxxi gladiator located at the Spearhead in Maldraxxus. He is presumably the creater of the nearby Fuseless Specials.
Mush Appreciated is an expansion feature achievement earned by reaching Exalted status with Marasmius.

Murloc Hideaway is a beach area situated on the southern coast of Exile's Reach, riddled with ship wreckages from both factions. The beaches are swarming with murlocs and other aquatic animals. It's where the player wakes up after the ship gets struck by a massive wave.

The Munificent Dagger is created with a Munificent Armament.
The Munificent Longbow is created with a Munificent Armament.

The Munificent Scepter is created with a Munificent Armament.
Murderous Cuffs are a quest reward from Verog the Dervish (quest).
Murkbrine Fishmancers are murlocs located in Stormheim during the Tazavesh, the Veiled Market dungeon.
Murkbrine Scalebinders are murlocs located in Stormheim during the Tazavesh, the Veiled Market dungeon.
Murkbrine Shellcrushers are murlocs located in Stormheim during the Tazavesh, the Veiled Market dungeon.
Murkbrine Shorerunners are murlocs located in Stormheim during the Tazavesh, the Veiled Market dungeon.
Murkbrine Wavejumpers are murlocs located in Stormheim during the Tazavesh, the Veiled Market dungeon.
The Murkweed Elixir is provided as an objective for The Forgotten Tale.
__NOTOC__ Mushan Nomads are mushan located at Sunsoaked Meadow and south of Mudmug's Place in the Valley of the Four Winds.
Museum Guard's Warboots are a quest reward from Priceless Treasures.
__NOTOC__ Munitioner Vizic is a Maldraxxi abomination located in Maldraxxus.
Muradin Hood is a world drop and is looted from Cache of Eregos.
Muradin Pants are a world drop and are looted from Patroller's Pack.
Murkastrasza is an Alexstrasza-themed murloc companion obtained from 's Collector's Edition, Epic Edition or Heroic Edition.
The Mur'gul Shell Sucker appears in Rise of the Naga and drops a Ring of Protection and Runes. It is a much weaker version of the Mur'gul Cliffrunner.
__NOTOC__ The Mur'gul Clam Trapper appears in Rise of the Naga and drops a Rune of Greater Healing.

Muqur Rain-Touched is a centaur quest giver located at Timberstep Outpost in the Ohn'ahran Plains. He was wounded by the hornstrider Nergazurai while hunting and asks adventurers to gather reagents to cleanse the infection in the wound.
Murozond's Timeless Scale drops from Chrono-Lord Deios in Dawn of the Infinite.
Murky Depths Shoulderguards are sold by Murik and Lontupit in the Azure Span for .
__NOTOC__ Myolor Sunderfury is the keeper of the Great Forge in Ironforge. According to Mathias Shaw, Myolor and the other trainers in the Great Forge see and hear quite a bit.

For humans, the present has always mattered more than the past. They spend little time exploring their origins. As far as they are concerned, they have always been here. (Older races raise an eyebrow at this assertion, but even the elves must admit that human tribes were well established when the elves discovered them.) In contrast, dwarves have always been curious about their origins. Their oldest dwellings and relics contained hints at an origin myth, but only after their recent arrival upon Kalimdor did the dwarves see the larger truth behind their fragmented legends. Based on scattered ruins they discovered in the wilds of Kalimdor, the dwarves were apparently created by a now-vanished r
Mutanus the Devourer is the last boss of the Wailing Caverns.

Muyoh is a tauren and a disciple of Naralex found in the Wailing Caverns and the Overgrown Camp in Southern Barrens. Muyoh is one who has remained uncorrupted within the Wailing Caverns. Once you enter the instance, he is the first thing you'll meet. He informs you that Naralex has gone to sleep. Naralex's dreams then became nightmares, which is the cause of so many deviate creatures appearing in the Wailing Caverns. However, he can't wake up Naralex and end his nightmare until the four Fanglords are defeated. Thus, he asks you to eliminate the four leaders of the corrupted druids. When you talk to him, he will cast Mark of the Wild rank 2 on you.
Mydrannul is a night elf general goods vendor located in the Warrior's Terrace in Darnassus. During the Burning of Teldrassil, he was caught in the chaos and could be saved.
Mysterious Fossil is provided as an objective for the following quests: *The Absent Minded Prospector (3) *The Absent Minded Prospector (4)
Mux's Quality Goods is a quest reward from The Ectoplasmic Distiller.

Myranda the Hag is a gnome located on a stub at Sorrow Hill in the Western Plaguelands. She was once a master illusionist of Lordaeron and Tirion Fordring's most trusted advisor when he held rank as Lord of Mardenholde. She openly dissented the verdict passed by the Order of the Silver Hand and was banished for her actions. She also knew Rexxar and Rokaro, and owes Thrall several favors.
Myrmidon's Signet drops from: * Colossus of Zora in Silithus * Colossus of Ashi in Silithus * Colossus of Regal in Silithus * Winterfall Ursa in Winterspring * Scholomance Adept in Scholomance
__NOTOC__ Mystery Meat can be looted from most level 30-58 beast monsters.
Muuran is a tauren mace vendor located in Ghost Walker Post in Desolace.

creep.]] .]] Though murlocs abound along the rugged coastal regions of Kalimdor, there is a mutant strain of the race that has emerged in months recent to the Third War. Though it is unclear what has caused the creature's strange mutations, many agree that something dark and sinister is awakening deep beneath the raging Maelstrom. The mutant murlocs have been so corrupted that they have been known to turn on their own brethren under duress.
Myrmidon's Headdress is a quest reward from The Warlord's Hideout.
__NOTOC__ Mycah is a sporeling faction rewards vendor located at Sporeggar in Zangarmarsh.
Mysterious Tanzanite is an gem that fits a red or yellow socket.
The Mysteries of the Light can be found in Hellfire Peninsula.
Someone should know what to do with this mask, now that it's been fixed! This is part of the quest chain.

The Mysterious Unhatched Egg is a quality item dropped from birds and certain owlkin. They can be found in Winterspring, Badlands, Deadwind Pass, Azshara, Felwood, Blasted Lands, and Western Plaguelands. They are not known to have any use, though they are the subject of several online rumors. These sell for 19s and may be profitable to sell in the AH, despite their apparent uselessness.
Mutilated Rat Carcass was once contained in the Buccaneer's Strongbox until it was removed at some point.
Mystery Stew is created by Cooking (175); taught by Recipe: Mystery Stew.
__NOTOC__ Mutated Tanglers are orchids found on Bloodmyst Isle.
Mysterious Relic drops from Lord Shalzaru in Feralas. This item is provided for Delivering the Relic.
__NOTOC__ Myst Spinners are giant spiders located in Bloodmyst Isle.
The Mysterious Artifact is looted from the Worn Coffer in the Woods' End Cabin in Gilneas.
__NOTOC__ Mutated Venture Co. Drones are undead found in the Northern Barrens.
Musty Scroll is found within the cave protected by raptors in Dustwallow Marsh.
The Mysterious Eastvale Haystack is located in Eastvale Logging Camp of Elwynn Forest.
The Mysterious Wailing Caverns Chest is located in Wailing Caverns.
The Mysterious Tree Stump is located in Palemane Rock of Mulgore.
Mycah's Botanical Bag is a bag that will hold herbs and various other herb related drops/items.
__NOTOC__ Mutinous Sea Dogs are ghouls found in the hold of the Sister Mercy that travels between Garvan's Reef and Sorlof's Strand in the Howling Fjord.
Mysterious Shadow Crystal is a socketed gem crafted by Jewelcrafting.
Musings of the High General drops from Scarlet Crusade members in the Scarlet Enclave.
My Love is Like a Red, Red Rose is an objective of the meta-achievement, Fool For Love.
Mysterious Twilight Opal is a socketed gem crafted by Jewelcrafting.
The Mysterious Bag is created with Tailoring (440); taught by Pattern: Mysterious Bag, a Wyrmrest Accord reputation reward.
Mysterious Dreadstone is a socketed gem crafted by Jewelcrafting.

My Girl Loves To Skadi All The Time is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating Skadi the Ruthless in Utgarde Pinnacle on Heroic difficulty after having killed Grauf from 100 to dead in a single pass.
__NOTOC__ Musselback Sculpin can be fished from waters in Borean Tundra and Dragonblight; see also Musselback Sculpin School.
The Musselback Sculpin Schools can be found in Lake Kum'uya in the Borean Tundra, West of the D.E.H.T.A. Encampment, just off the road.
Myra was the wife of Halsand and the mother of Jake, Rose and Tulip. She lives on a farm with her family.
Mysteries of the Marsh is a quest achievement earned by completing Zangarmarsh quests.
Must Deconstruct Faster (10 player) is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating XT-002 Deconstructor in 205 seconds on 10-player mode.
My Storage is "Gigantique" is a collections achievement earned for equipping Haris Pilton's "Gigantique" Bag.

The Musty Coffin is a coffin with Malmortis inside. It can be found in the north west area on the upper level of Voltarus, exactly where you port in from. When clicked on Malmortis will spawn and offer to give players a tour of the second level of Voltarus for the quest Disclosure.
__NOTOC__ Myralion Sunblaze is a blood elf found in Icecrown. He also appears in the Frozen Halls in Icecrown Citadel.
Myatis is a kind of coating, which preserves everything soaked in it, no matter how long.
Mysterious Pearls drop from Idra'kess Prophets and Idra'kess Warlords in Shimmering Expanse.
Mutilated Mistwing Carcasses drop from Mistwing Cliffdwellers in Azshara.
Mysterious Potion restores randomly 0 to 50000 health and 10 to 20000 mana, within 1 minute cooldown outside combat.
Mylra's Knife is provided as an objective for Big Game, Big Bait.
Mysterious Fortune Cards can be flipped to reveal a random Fortune Card with a value ranging from to . This item is created with Cataclysm Inscription (1); the recipe is taught by trainers.

A Mutant Goblin emerges from a building in the Secret Lab after players ring the Buzzer for service during the quest Nine's Plan. He drops the Secret Rocket Plans, the raptor Subject Nine needs for a plot to escape. Additionally, he drops his Secret Lab ID Card, confirming his former identity as X. Nizzlebex. The Mutant Goblin is not a huge challenge, but has two "adds" in his the form of his Mutant Tentacles. They will still remain to attack players after he is defeated. The separated tentacles can move around on their own, are not forced remain stationary.

The Mutant Goblin found in the Secret Lab has two Mutant Tentacles that serve as "adds" of a sort when players need to defeat him. Although attached to him at first, the tentacles will stick around once he is defeated and need to be dealt with as well.
Mylune is a forest nymph located at the Grove of Aessina in Mount Hyjal, and is later found as a champion in the Dreamgrove.
My Very Own Broodmother is a quest achievement earned for speedily completing the Therazane revered daily quest The Restless Brood.

A musk bomb is a foot-long copper cylinder perforated with holes. When the ring on one end is tugged, a bladed rod at the center of the cylinder rips through the small bladders inside to release the concentrated scents of a dozen creatures.

Mylune's Call is sold by Varlan Highbough to players who have completed phase 4 of the Molten Front. It surrounds the player with a green glow while plants sprout and woodland creatures cavort. The effect lasts about half a minute.
A Mutated Corruption appears shortly after assaulting a platform during the Deathwing encounter.
__NOTOC__ Mutated Silkmoths are moths located at the Silken Fields in the Valley of the Four Winds.
__NOTOC__ Mutated Silkworms are caterpillars located at the Silken Fields in the Valley of the Four Winds.
This quest is mutually exclusive with Beyond the Wall. Only one of the quests may be accepted concurrently.

Muskpaw Jr. is a pandaren from Muskpaw Ranch in Kun-Lai Summit. He got himself grabbed by a group of sprites to Pranksters' Hollow. Adventurers, sent by his father Lao Muskpaw, defeated the Needle Sprites that jumped him. He then returned with Floof and Tuffi to Lao & Son's Yakwash where he washed Escaped Yaks and hoped Lao wouldn't go against the invading yaungol.

Muskpaw Ranch was the home of Lao Muskpaw, his wife and his son before the yaungol of the Burilgi tribe razed it. It can be found just inland of Lao & Son's Yakwash on the Autumn Plains, south of Fire Camp Ruqin.
Mygoness is a mistlurker located at Rikkilea in the Dread Wastes.
Mutant Bush Chickens are critters found in the Forsaken Rear Guard in Silverpine Forest.
The Mysterious Note was provided for Stranger in a Strange Land (quest).
My Diamonds and Your Rust is a player vs. player achievement earned for winning a match without letting the enemy team capture a mine cart in Silvershard Mines.
Must Love Dogs is an achievement that is awarded for defeating The Stone Guard in the Mogu'shan Vaults raid instance while every member of your raid is accompanied by a canine companion pet.
__NOTOC__ Muurald is a tauren general goods vendor located at the Emerald Sanctuary in Felwood.
The Mysterious Winged Spirit is a spirit located at the Shrine of Aviana in Winterspring. She is the spirit of Aviana and can only be seen by pouring the Sacred Nectar in Aviana's Burial Circle.
The Mysterious Imperial Amethyst is a jewelcrafting crafted gem. It is taught by Imperial Amethyst (recipe) or Secrets of the Stone.
Mutilax is a rare wasp that can be found to the northeast of Northridge Lumber Camp in Western Plaguelands.

The Mysterious Flower of Frostfire Ridge is found at on the Southwind Cliffs, a few hundred yards southeast of the Iron Horde Supplies wagon that got stuck in the snow. Interact with it and a small script event plays out: :Grom'kar Deadeye is stabbed in the stomach by another orc, and then falls to the ground. :
The Mysterious Flask can drop from any mob in for alchemists, but most likely from . It starts , which begins a short chain to unlock the Alchemy Lab blueprints for the Garrison.

Mysterious Petrified Pods are found inside some Hardened Thornvine at various locations in Gorgrond. Players who elected to take the Lumber Mill can interact with the thornvine to free the Mysterious Petrified Pod, which can be looted for some Garrison Resources.

Mutafen is found just west of Pinchwhistle Point in southern Spires of Arak. It spawns in three colors, blue, green and yellow. When first killed, Mutafen will drop a Mutafen's Mighty Maul along with 20-30 garrison Resources.
Mya Springbloom is a prisoner of the Horde in Ashran, found in Warspear Outpost. Mya cannot be freed by players.
The Mysterious Orc appears after interacting with a Mysterious Flower, which can be found in every zone of , and kills a Grom'kar Deadeye. The orc can be found at and wields the Mysterious Flower.
Mysterious Shining Lockbox is a reward from the rare mission Finding Farahlon.

:Deep in the heart of Blackrock Depths is a track so legendary, it takes two dragons to protect it. Music Roll: Legends of Azeroth drops from the Nefarian's End encounter in Blackwing Descent. As with all music rolls, players must have completed Bringing the Bass before being able to acquire this roll. Like the other music roll boss drops, the drop chance is not 100%. "Legends of Azeroth" was the main theme for World of Warcraft before the launch of Burning Crusade, and served as the game's login music during that period.

:Up for a journey into the Black Temple? You still won't be prepared for the hard hitting bass of the track you'll find. Music Roll: The Burning Legion drops from Illidan Stormrage in the Black Temple. As with all music rolls, players must have completed Bringing the Bass before being able to acquire this roll. Like other music roll boss drops, the drop chance is not 100%. To get to Illidan, all other bosses in the instance must be killed. "The Burning Legion" was the main theme of the Burning Crusade expansion and served as the game's login music for that period.

]] :You're already leading a campaign against the Iron Horde. Might as well take Blackhand's music roll collection while you're at it. A Siege of Worlds drops from Blackhand in Blackrock Foundry. As with all music rolls, players must have completed Bringing the Bass before being able to acquire this roll. Like the other music roll boss drops, the drop chance is not 100%. "A Siege of Worlds" was the main theme for the Warlords of Draenor expansion and served as the game's login music during that period.

Music Roll: Faerie Dragon can be looted from the Faerie Dragon Nest during the Fey-Drunk Darter event at in western Tirisfal Glades, west of Deathknell. As with all music rolls, players must have completed Bringing the Bass before being able to acquire this roll. The event starts roughly every 15 minutes. Once the faerie dragons line up over the mushroom circle and start channeling toward the center, the nest will spawn in the middle. Loot it quickly, as the event does not run for long.

:Conquering fear itself will help you glimpse the Heart of Pandaria, musically speaking, of course. Music Roll: Heart of Pandaria drops from the Sha of Fear encounter in the Terrace of Endless Spring. As with all music rolls, players must have completed Bringing the Bass before being able to acquire this roll. Like the other boss drops, the item does not have a 100% drop chance. "Heart of Pandaria" was the the main theme for the Mists of Pandaria expansion and seved as the game's login music during that period.

:Lion's Landing has a track as fresh as the sea. Watch out for sharks! Music Roll: High Seas is sold by Proveditor Grantley at on Lion's Landing in Krasarang Wilds for to Alliance players only. As with all music rolls, players must have completed Bringing the Bass before being able to acquire this roll. The Horde equivalent is Music Roll: War March.

Music Roll: Invincible drops from the Lich King in Icecrown Citadel. As with all music rolls, players must have completed Bringing the Bass before being able to acquire this roll. Like all music roll boss drops, the drop chance is not 100%. "Invincible" is heavily tied to the rise and fall of Arthas Menethil as the Lich King, and this version of the song was played in the ending cinematic of Wrath of the Lich King after Arthas was defeated atop Icecrown Citadel.

Music Roll: Karazhan Opera House drops from the Opera event boss in Karazhan. As with all music rolls, players must have completed Bringing the Bass before being able to acquire this roll. Like all music roll boss drops, the drop chance is not 100%. To let Barnes, the stage manager, start up the opera event, defeat Moroes in the Banquet Hall.

Music Roll: The Zandalari drops from Jin'do the Godbreaker in Zul'Gurub for Horde players only. As with all music rolls, players must have completed Bringing the Bass before being able to acquire this roll. Like all music roll boss drops, the drop chance is not 100%. The Alliance version of this item is Music Roll: Tinkertown.
Music Roll: Thunder Bluff is contained in the Stash of Dusty Music Rolls, awarded for completing Bringing the Bass by Horde players.

Music Roll: Tinkertown is found inside a Sparklematic-Wrapped Box in Gnomeregan for Alliance players only. As with all music rolls, players must have completed Bringing the Bass before being able to acquire this roll. To acquire Sparklematic-Wrapped Boxes, enter the front door of Gnomeregan and start killing a path to the Clean Zone, looting irradiated troggs along the way and picking up their Grime-Encrusted Object. In the Clean Zone, interact with any of the Sparklematic 5200s in the room and complete More Sparklematic Action (or the one-off quest The Sparklematic 5200! (1) if necessary). Keep repeating the quest and opening the box until the music roll is found inside. The Horde version o

Music Roll: Totems of the Grizzlemaw is given to players who answer Remington Brode's four questions correctly. As with all music rolls, players must have completed Bringing the Bass before being able to acquire this roll. Brode wanders a circuitous path around Grizzly Hills from Ashwood Post at through Solstice Village past the Westfall Brigade Encampment and the Heartwood Trading Post, through the Vordrassil Pass, then makes a clockwise loop around Amberpine Lodge and Conquest Hold, finally stopping at the Aspen Grove Post at north of Amberpine.

Music Roll: Song of Liu Lang is sold by Tan Shin Tiao for at on the Seat of Knowledge in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms when with the Lorewalkers. As with all music rolls, players must have completed Bringing the Bass before being able to acquire this roll.

Music Roll: The Argent Tournament is sold by the faction vendors for at the Argent Tournament in Icecrown after reaching Exalted Champion with any one of the racial factions. Players must be Exalted Champion with that specific vendor's faction in order to see the item. As with all music rolls, players must have completed Bringing the Bass before being able to acquire this roll. Only one faction is required, not all five.

Mustazaar is a draenei found upstairs in Hero's Rest Inn in Stormshield.
The Mystery Keg is a quest reward from Not In Your Army and Cleaning House (Spires of Arak) in Spires of Arak.
__NOTOC__ Mychele Morrowsong is a blood elf follower located in Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Frostwall Tavern.
Myra Hackenslash is an goblin follower located at Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Frostwall Tavern.

Myonix is a large manasaber who dwells near the river in northern Suramar. She is a mother of four kittens, and will not hesitate to savagely defend them.

The Mysterious Satchel can drop from any mob in for tailors, but most likely to from Karnoth for the quest Shadows Awaken in Teluuna Observatory at Embaari Village. It starts A Mysterious Satchel, which begins a short chain to unlock the Scribe's Quarters blueprints for the Garrison.

.]] Musken (or runehorn) are large, yak-like bovines native to Stormheim on the Broken Isles and the Ohn'ahran Plains on the Dragon Isles. They have three pairs of horns and braids similar to those of male vrykul. Their fur is incredibly thick and broom-like. They mostly use their horns for defense, however some use their tough hooves.
The Mysterious Cube drops from the Chronomatic Anomaly in the Nighthold. It can be obtained in any difficulty.

__NOTOC__ Muyani is a tauren located at the Wailing Caverns in the Northern Barrens. Suspecting that the corpse of Verdan the Everliving may have something to do with the multiplying and growing numbers of deviate critters Muyani has requested adventurers to delve into the caverns to discover the truth of the matter. Mysterious Coin is a quest reward from Eating Into Our Business.

Mysterious Ogre Ninja was an ogre located in Frostfire Ridge. He found a huge supply cache, but was taken out by the followers sent from the garrisons.

Mutated Nautilus drops from the Mistress Sassz'ine in the Tomb of Sargeras.
My'das Talisman drops from Priestess Alun'za in Atal'Dazar. __NOTOC__

The Musty Cloth is located at at Auchindoun of Terokkar Forest as part of the It's a Waist of Time secret.
The Mutilated Zandalari is a Zandalari troll located at the Mugambala in Zuldazar. She can be found in a bush behind the store of Simon Redhands.
Myra Rotspring is an undead who works for . She specializes in poisons and seeks to master her new discovery, Necrium.
Mysterious Petrified Egg drops from Imonar the Soulhunter in Antorus, the Burning Throne.

Mysterious Trashpiles (referred to as Shrines of Scavengers by Jani) are objects found in various locations throughout Zandalar. Approaching one will afflict the player with the "Disturbingly Divine Presence" debuff, informing them that "A strong presence is near". Interacting with a Trashpile will transport the player to a redshifted version of the world where they can commune with Jani, the saurid loa, and receive or complete tasks for him. The player can return to the regular world by simply talking to Jani and asking him to release them.

Myndflame Entertainment is a group that produces popular machinima about World of Warcraft, such as the Illegal Danish series. Their website also hosts a variety of machinima from other groups and people.
Mutants are creatures that have been mutated by something. Mutants have appeared in Warcraft III, World of Warcraft, and the RPGs.

An abbreviation or acronym used in party conversation as an abbreviation for need when an item is being rolled for meaning "I need this item" when observing a particular type of looting etiquette described in Need before Greed. Antonym of G (looting).
Myzrael is an earth elemental summoned in the Circle of Inner Binding in the Arathi Highlands and also found roaming a small area in Deepholm.
Mythidan is a night elf mace and staff vendor located in the Tradesmen's Terrace in Darnassus. During the Burning of Teldrassil, he was caught in the chaos and could be saved.

Mythrin'dir is a night elf general trade vendor located in the Craftsmen's Terrace in Darnassus. During the Burning of Teldrassil, he was caught in the chaos and could be saved. Years later, Mythrin'dir in the Central Encampment under Amirdrassil in the Emerald Dream.
Mystic Yayo'jin is a jungle troll reagent vendor located in Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands. You can find her on a platform on the north side the village.
This article concerns mythic creatures that have been referenced in Warcraft sources but which have no lore describing their existence as actual races.
